_comment: Ratchet for scripts/coverage-budget.mjs (FE-157 5A.1). Floors, in percent, for `vitest run --coverage` over src/**/*.{ts,vue}; raised 2026-11-10 to the measured 89.76 / 83.45 / 85.21 / 91.27, rounded down to 0.1. They may only go up: when the measured value is higher, the script says so -- raise the floor in the same commit (the script flags a gap of 0.2 points or more). Lowering one is not allowed.
